items.q: Do I pay before I design?
items.a: No. Designing and previewing are free. You pay once when you publish the invitation.

items.q: How do guests receive the invitation?
items.a: You get a private link. Share it on WhatsApp, SMS or any app — guests open it in their browser.
Yes. Each invitation can collect responses, and you see the totals in your dashboard.

items.q: Can I change the invitation after publishing?
items.a: Yes. You can edit details at any time and the link stays the same.

items.q: Who can see my guest list?
items.a: Only you. Guest names and phone numbers are never shown publicly.

items.q: Is the invitation available in English too?
items.a: Yes. Invitations and the whole site work in Arabic and English.

sections.p: Invitation 4u lets you design digital invitations, publish them as shareable links and collect guest responses and blessings. By using the site or creating an account you agree to these terms.
Give accurate details. You are responsible for your account, your password and everything done through it. Tell us right away if you suspect unauthorised use.

You own the content you upload or write (text, photos, music). You give us a limited licence to host and display it only as needed to run your invitation link. You confirm you have the right to use it and that it does not break the law or anyone's rights. We may take down invitations with abusive or unlawful content.

You can publish on the free plan (watermarked, limited time) or on a paid plan, paid once per invitation, at the price in Egyptian pounds shown at checkout. There are no subscriptions or automatic renewals. Prices may change; a payment you have completed is never repriced.

Payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy as the Merchant of Record, which collects payment, issues the receipt and handles applicable taxes. We never store your card details. Your statement may show Lemon Squeezy or our name. A paid invitation is published only after payment is confirmed.
The refund policy on the "Refund policy" page is part of these terms.
Do not use the platform for fraud, spam, publishing other people's data without permission, or to attack, disrupt or bypass the limits of the service.

We aim for reliable service but cannot promise it will be uninterrupted or error free. To the extent the law allows, our liability is limited to the amount you paid for the invitation concerned. Keep your own copy of your event details.
You can delete your invitation or account at any time. We may suspend or end accounts that break these terms.

We may update these terms and will tell you about material changes; continuing to use the service means you accept them. Use the Contact page for questions. These terms are governed by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.

Account details (name, email, a hashed password), the invitations you create including photos and music, guest names and phone numbers you enter, responses and blessings your guests send, a view count per invitation (a number only, no visitor identity), and basic technical data such as server logs to keep the service safe.
To run the service, show your invitation to the people you share the link with, process payments, answer your questions and prevent abuse. We do not use your data for advertising.

Guest lists and phone numbers are visible only to the invitation owner and are never shown publicly. The public page shows only what you choose to publish, and the names and messages of people who leave blessings may appear in the guestbook.

Lemon Squeezy processes payments as the Merchant of Record and collects card and billing details under its own policy. We receive only what we need to confirm a payment (status, amount and reference) and never see your card details.
We use one essential cookie to keep you signed in. We use no tracking or advertising cookies.
We do not sell personal data. We share it only with service providers needed to run the platform, such as payment and hosting providers, or when the law requires it.

We keep your data while your account exists. When you delete an invitation or your account its data is deleted, and backups may keep a copy for a short time (about 14 days) before being erased. We may keep payment records for as long as the law requires.
You can ask us to access, correct or delete your data through the Contact page, and we will reply within a reasonable time.
We may update this policy and will publish the new version on this page.
Nothing is charged while you design or on the free plan. You pay only when you choose a paid plan and publish.
You can ask for a full refund within 14 days of payment, as long as the event date has not passed. Write to us through the Contact page with your account email and the order or receipt number.
When a refund is approved the paid invitation is taken offline and its link stops working. You keep your draft and can use the free plan.
The refund goes back to the payment method you used, through Lemon Squeezy. It usually appears within 5 to 10 business days depending on your card's bank.

If you were charged but your invitation was not published, charged twice, or the service failed because of a problem on our side, we refund in full even after the period above. Contact us with the order reference.
Payments are not refunded after 14 days or after the event date, except in the special cases above.
